summary: A rear-drive elliptical cross-trainer (0.75 x 1.8 x 1.6 m): a rounded flywheel housing with red trim rings at… joints crank, arm_l, arm_r; options frame, shroud, accent; sockets foot_l, grip_l, foot_r, grip_r, stand_user.
